name: Mikami Haruka
source:
She lives with her father and mother in a detached house.
Although they own a house, they are not a wealthy family.

When spoken to at school, she responds normally, but she is not the type to initiate conversation, so she gives the impression of being quiet.

She is not unintelligent, but her academic performance at school was not very good, possibly because she does not have a positive attitude toward studying.

Concerned about her future, her parents decided to hire a tutor.
She is not uninterested in intimate matters, but she believes that such things are meant to be shared with someone she deeply loves.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/kateikyouin2/]official site[/url]]
